items.exampleEn: The old poems exalt the beauty of the mountains.
items.exampleZh: 那些古詩讚頌群山之美。

items.exampleEn: Some parents are too indulgent and never say no.
items.exampleZh: 有些父母太縱容，從來不說「不」。

items.exampleEn: The player was dropped from the team for dishonesty.
items.exampleZh: 那名球員因為不誠實被踢出球隊。

items.exampleEn: Unkind words can hurt more than you think.
items.exampleZh: 不友善的話可能比你想的更傷人。

items.exampleEn: He foolishly believed every rumor he heard.
items.exampleZh: 他愚蠢地相信聽到的每一個謠言。

items.exampleEn: There was no conceit in her; she always thanked her team.
items.exampleZh: 她一點也不自負，總是感謝她的團隊。

items.exampleEn: In the fairy tale, the giant cruelly locks the prince in a tower.
items.exampleZh: 在那個童話故事裡，巨人殘忍地把王子關在塔裡。

items.exampleEn: Her narcissistic friend posts photos of herself online every day.
items.exampleZh: 她那個自戀的朋友每天都在網路上貼自己的照片。

items.sentenceEn: I foolishly forgot my keys and had to wait outside for an hour.
items.sentenceZh: 我傻傻地忘了帶鑰匙，只好在外面等了一個小時。

items.audioEn: It was unkind of him to forget her birthday, but he said sorry to her the next day.
items.audioZh: 他忘了她的生日，很不應該，不過隔天他向她道歉了。
options: He waited a week to say sorry

items.sentenceEn: The new manager exalted the team's hard work in her speech.
items.sentenceZh: 新經理在演說中大力讚揚團隊的努力。

items.sentenceEn: The indulgent owner lets his dog sleep on the bed every night.
items.sentenceZh: 那位縱容的主人每天晚上都讓狗睡在床上。

items.stemEn: His ____ made him think he was smarter than everyone else.
items.stemZh: 他的自負讓他以為自己比所有人都聰明。

items.stemEn: My ____ roommate spends an hour every morning looking at himself in the mirror.
items.stemZh: 我那自戀的室友每天早上都花一個小時照鏡子看自己。

items.passageEn: This season, my favorite cooking show has a new cook called Kurt. Kurt is talented but arrogant, and his conceit annoys everyone. In every episode, he talks about how great he is, which seems a little narcissistic. Last week, he was unkind to a quiet young cook and cruelly laughed at her cake. Then he foolishly tried to hide a burned dish, and the judges soon found out about his dishonesty. The audience cheered when the quiet cook won the round.
items.passageZh: 這一季，我最喜歡的烹飪節目來了一位新廚師叫 Kurt。Kurt 很有才華但很傲慢，他的自負讓大家都很受不了。每一集他都在講自己有多厲害，看起來有點自戀。上週，他對一位安靜的年輕廚師很不友善，還刻薄地嘲笑她的蛋糕。接著他又愚蠢地想藏起一盤燒焦的菜，評審很快就發現他不誠實。那位安靜的廚師贏得這一回合時，觀眾都歡呼了。

items.promptZh: 不誠實可能會毀掉一段友誼。
referenceEn: A friendship can be destroyed by dishonesty.
A friendship can be ruined by dishonesty.
rubricZh: 要用 dishonesty（例如 Dishonesty can…、be ruined by dishonesty 等），主動句、被動句都可以

items.promptZh: 她對新同學很不友善，從來不跟他說話。
referenceEn: She is unkind to the new classmate and never talks to him.
She is very unkind to the new student; she never speaks to him.
rubricZh: unkind 當形容詞，常接 to＋人（例如 is unkind to the new classmate 等）
「新同學」可寫，例如 the new classmate、the new student 等
時態可用現在式、過去式或現在完成式（例如 is、was、has been 等）
